title: Pose
description: A position in meters and an orientation as a unit quaternion (w, x, y, z) in a declared frame. `euler` (roll, pitch, yaw in radians, intrinsic Z-Y-X) is the earlier form of the orientation: it is deprecated, optional, and only accepted next to the quaternion so that an old reader still finds it.

orientation.description: A unit quaternion: w*w + x*x + y*y + z*z = 1 within 1e-6 (checked by the clients, a schema cannot express it).
